name: Roast Sweet Potatoes with Holiday Spiced Honey Butter

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel, and trim sweet potatoes; slice crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Drizzle sweet potatoes with oil, season with salt and pepper, then toss to coat.  Spread the slices out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, flipping the slices halfway through baking, until sweet potato is fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Just before serving, combine butter, honey, and spices in a small saucepan. Place over medium-low heat and whisk until melted and bubbly. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
3 tbsp honey
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp clove, ground
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Arrange sweet potato slices, slightly overlapping them, on a platter; drizzle spiced honey butter over top.
